description: Monorepo scaffold (tasks.md 1.1) + docs/LICENSES.md bootstrap (tasks.md 1.7). Create the exact folder layout from steering/structure.md, the pnpm workspace, root tooling, and the seeded license table. Foundational: all other features build on this. Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 except that it must exist first.
steps: Create root `package.json` at c:\data\kucing\texora\.worktrees\m1-skeleton\package.json: private:true, packageManager pinned to pnpm@9.x.x, workspace-level scripts (lint/test/build that delegate into apps/desktop).

Create `.editorconfig`, `.gitignore` (node_modules, dist, target, __pycache__, .venv, PyInstaller build/dist, apps/desktop/src-tauri/binaries/* frozen sidecars, local logs), `LICENSE` (MIT — permissive-first), `README.md` stub (name, one-line desc, M1 status, build-from-source placeholder).
Create `pipeline.yaml` placeholder with commented stage keys (ingest/layout/recognize/ensemble/export) and a note that defaults are set by M7 benchmarks.

Create the full directory tree per steering/structure.md with .gitkeep in empty dirs: apps/desktop/, engine/texora_engine/{api,ingest,layout,recognizers,ensemble,export,jobs,models,db}/, engine/tests/, benchmarks/, docs/, scripts/.

Create `docs/LICENSES.md` with columns Dependency|Version|Ecosystem|License|Personal use|Redistribute|Notes. Seed rows for the pins that WILL be added across M1 (FastAPI, uvicorn, pydantic, pydantic-settings, httpx, pytest, pytest-asyncio, ruff, black, mypy, PyInstaller + hooks-contrib, Tauri, @tauri-apps/cli+api, React, react-dom, Vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, Tailwind, TypeScript, vitest, @testing-library/react, jsdom, ESLint, typescript-eslint, Prettier, and Rust crates rand/reqwest-or-ureq/tokio/serde). Verify each license against official package metadata before writing — do not guess.

Add a 'Deferred / opt-in only' subsection to docs/LICENSES.md naming PyMuPDF (AGPL -> opt-in local only, never default; pypdfium2 is the chosen renderer, added in M3) and Surya (GPL code + non-commercial RAIL weights -> opt-in local only, not redistributable), with an explicit line stating neither is an M1 dependency.
Run `corepack enable pnpm` (or `npm i -g pnpm@9`) then `pnpm install` at the root to confirm the workspace resolves.
Commit locally with a conventional-commit message (e.g. 'chore: scaffold monorepo and seed LICENSES'). Do not push.
acceptance_criteria: The directory tree matches steering/structure.md exactly (apps/desktop, engine/texora_engine/<9 subfolders>, engine/tests, benchmarks, docs, scripts, pipeline.yaml, root pnpm workspace).
`pnpm install` at the root exits 0 and writes pnpm-lock.yaml.
docs/LICENSES.md exists with a row for every dependency that M1 will add, each with license + personal-use + redistribute verdict, plus the PyMuPDF/Surya opt-in policy section.
No Surya or PyMuPDF dependency appears anywhere in the repo.
verification: Run `corepack enable pnpm` (or install pnpm) then `pnpm install` at c:\data\kucing\texora\.worktrees\m1-skeleton — expect exit 0.
List the tree and confirm it matches steering/structure.md and that each empty stage folder has a .gitkeep.
Confirm docs/LICENSES.md contains the seeded rows and the opt-in policy section (the dep-row-vs-manifest cross-check becomes fully enforceable once FEAT-002/003 add their manifests; note that here).
findings:
DONE on branch feat/m1-skeleton (commit 8a61f72). Scaffold matches steering/structure.md exactly.

KEY DECISIONS / THINGS LATER FEATURES NEED:
- pnpm pin: packageManager=pnpm@9.15.9 (final 9.x). System pnpm is 12.11.2 but corepack honors the pinned 9.15.9. `corepack enable pnpm` FAILS on this host (EPERM writing shims to C:\Program Files\nodejs). WORKAROUND: use `corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.9 --activate` once, then run pnpm as `corepack pnpm <cmd>` (do NOT rely on a global `pnpm` shim).
- PATH: toolchains are installed but not all on default bash PATH. Prepend this before every build/test cmd: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/Python/Python311:$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/Python/Python311/Scripts:$LOCALAPPDATA/Microsoft/WinGet/Packages/pnpm.pnpm_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe:$PATH". Verified available: node 24.14.0, cargo/rustc/clippy 1.99.1, python 3.11.9 (pip 24.0). Use the Python311 path explicitly for the engine venv (system `python` is 3.14).
- Project license: MIT (LICENSE file + README). Permissive-first.
- Root package.json name="texora", private, workspace scripts lint/test/build/tauri delegate to `--filter desktop` (so apps/desktop MUST set package name to `desktop` in FEAT-002).
- pnpm-workspace.yaml packages: ['apps/*']. pnpm install exits 0 and wrote pnpm-lock.yaml (lockfileVersion 9.0, empty importers since no deps yet). No node_modules created (nothing to install yet) — expected.
- Empty stage dirs each carry a .gitkeep; delete the .gitkeep when a real file lands.
- Tauri sidecar/crate naming reminder (from context.json): Cargo crate `texora-desktop`, sidecar base name `texora-engine` (must differ). binaries/ contents are gitignored except .gitkeep.
- .gitignore keeps PyInstaller .spec files tracked (they are build inputs) but ignores engine/build, engine/dist, build/.
- docs/LICENSES.md is SEEDED with M1 pins; licenses VERIFIED against PyPI/npm/crates.io metadata (fastapi MIT, uvicorn BSD-3, pydantic/pydantic-settings MIT, httpx BSD-3, pytest MIT, pytest-asyncio Apache-2.0, ruff/black/mypy MIT, pyinstaller GPL-2.0-or-later WITH Bootloader-exception, hooks-contrib Apache-2.0 AND GPL-2.0, react/react-dom MIT, @tauri-apps/* 'Apache-2.0 OR MIT', vite/plugin-react MIT, tailwindcss MIT, typescript Apache-2.0, vitest MIT, @testing-library/react MIT, jsdom MIT, eslint MIT, typescript-eslint MIT, prettier MIT, tauri/tauri-build 'Apache-2.0 OR MIT', tokio MIT, serde/serde_json/rand/reqwest/ureq 'MIT OR Apache-2.0'). FEAT-002/003/004 MUST make their manifest versions match these rows (or update the row in the same change). The reqwest-vs-ureq rows are both present as candidates; FEAT-004 keeps one and removes the other. The dep-row-vs-manifest cross-check is only fully enforceable once those manifests exist.
- NO Surya / NO PyMuPDF anywhere; opt-in policy section documents them as deferred (pypdfium2 is the chosen renderer, added M3).
- .agents/ scratch dir was deliberately NOT committed.
